claim_scope: A fail-closed split-conformal decision contract for already-computed Route 1 pair differences. It returns a direction only after qualified complete-series calibration and never changes an energy. No calibration artifact or certified result is supplied by this protocol.

calibration_requirements.domain_policy: exact declared-domain match; no global fallback
calibration_requirements.minimum_series_per_domain: must be fixed before test labels are opened
calibration_requirements.finite_sample_attainability: for miscoverage alpha, each exact domain needs enough independent series that ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) <= n; otherwise return out_of_domain rather than clamp the quantile
calibration_requirements.sealed_parameter_binding: miscoverage, minimum_series_per_domain, and the complete-series maximum-error statistic are read from the calibration artifact rather than supplied at prediction time

failure_action: Return out_of_domain when qualified calibration or declared-domain support is absent; return uncertain when the conformal interval crosses zero or charge/endpoint order disagrees.
